provenance.quote: Should the governing authority of Union County be changed from a sole commissioner to a five-member board of commissioners?

measures.questionText: Should the governing authority of Union County be changed from a sole commissioner to a five-member board of commissioners?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Should the governing authority of Union County be changed from a sole commissioner to a five-member board of commissioners?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Asks whether Union County should replace its sole commissioner with a five-member board of commissioners. This is an advisory referendum asking voters for their preference; this Act does not itself establish the five-member board.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Advise in favor of changing from one commissioner to a five-member board.
